name: ModelVariant171_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant171_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (groups of points spread through a sphere in front of the other slot play an eight-frame texture as wobbling quads that converge on one of the slot's parts while their colour rises and fades, then a fixed burst frame fades out at each point's starting position); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-188 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant188_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
